title: Group chat blue composer + plan-gated color/effect style changer

requirements.text: Update the group chat composer (frontend GroupConversation) so the message input textbox is visually blue by default when chatting in groups (e.g., blue-tinted background/border/focus ring), without changing the direct-message chat textbox styling.

quotes: make text box where its blue when chat in groups

acceptanceCriteria: In group chats, the message input has a clearly blue visual style (background and/or border and/or focus ring).
In direct messages, the message input styling remains unchanged.

requirements.text: Add a group-chat composer “color changer” control that lets users choose/cycle message text colors with plan-based availability: Free/Normal = Normal only; Pro plan = Black, Orange, Blue, Purple; Ultra plan = adds Skulls effect and Flames effect; Ultimate plan = adds Dodge effect.

quotes: add color changer like black normal orange blue pro plan purple pro plan skulls ultra plan dodge ultimate plan flames ultra plan

acceptanceCriteria: The group composer shows controls to change message style before sending (color and effect).
Free/Normal users can only select Normal color and no special effects beyond None.
Pro users can select Black, Orange, Blue, and Purple colors.
Ultra users can select Skulls and Flames effects (in addition to prior unlocked options).
Ultimate users can select Dodge effect (in addition to prior unlocked options).

requirements.text: Implement locked-style handling in the group composer UI: styles not available to the current user’s plan must be visible but not selectable, and must show an English lock indicator (e.g., “Pro”, “Ultra”, “Ultimate”) and a toast/message explaining the required plan when clicked.

quotes: add color changer like black normal orange blue pro plan purple pro plan skulls ultra plan dodge ultimate plan flames ultra plan

acceptanceCriteria: Locked color/effect options are clearly marked with the required plan label in English.
Attempting to use a locked option does not change the selected style and shows an English explanation/toast indicating the required plan.

requirements.text: Extend message styling support end-to-end to include the newly requested options: add Purple and Blue message colors, and add a Dodge message effect, ensuring group messages preserve and render these styles consistently (send, store, fetch, and display).
acceptanceCriteria: Sending a group message with Purple or Blue selected results in recipients seeing the correct color styling on the message bubble text.
Sending a group message with Dodge selected results in recipients seeing a distinct (lightweight) Dodge effect rendering for that message.
Existing message styling (Normal/Black/Orange/Cyan and existing effects) continues to work.

requirements.text: Define and implement how the app determines the user’s plan tier (Free/Pro/Ultra/Ultimate) using the existing premium membership data model where possible; if new backend state is required, add it to the Motoko UserProfile and expose a query for the frontend to read the current tier.
acceptanceCriteria: The frontend can reliably determine the current user’s plan tier and use it to gate available chat styles in group chat.
Unauthenticated users or users without a profile are treated as Free/Normal for gating purposes.

requirements.text: Update the group chat composer default style behavior so that, in group chats, the default selected message color starts as Blue (and remains Blue after sending/reset), while preserving any existing default behavior in direct messages.

quotes: make text box where its blue when chat in groups

acceptanceCriteria: When opening a group conversation, the selected composer message color defaults to Blue.
After sending a group message, the composer selection resets back to Blue (not Normal).
Direct message composer behavior is unchanged.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo (no additional backend services).
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or other immutable frontend paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT; compose existing UI components instead.
nonGoals: Do not add message deletion, reactions, or emoji animations as part of this change.
Do not redesign the entire chat UI beyond the group composer textbox blue styling and the style changer controls.
